about: Hands-free on all 16 photos of the pantry set, in the order a volunteer would show them: 8 real products, each face held up in turn, a blank frame between items standing in for the empty table. rule: An item's answer is the last answer the app gives between the moment the item's first face appears and the moment the next item's first face appears. It is right when it is the expected one. 'turn_it' means the app asked for the item to be turned and did not keep, discard or set it aside: no photo of that item shows a date, so nothing else is right. A 'keep' with a registered keep_until is right only with that date. The corn is played and reported but not graded: the stamps on its lids could not be read by hand from the photo.
